title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg Is Hiding the DRAGON? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg is hiding the dragon inside? A purple egg, a golden egg, or a spotty blue egg? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #FunForKids #Kidify #Quiz #EggReveal

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON inside!
Is it the purple egg, the golden egg, or the spotty blue egg?
scenes.visual_prompt: purple gold blue Easter eggs row
scenes.on_screen_text: A) Purple  B) Golden  C) Spotty Blue

scenes.narration: The purple egg cracks open and… it's just a sock. A really smelly sock!
scenes.visual_prompt: cracked Easter egg silly sock inside

scenes.narration: The golden egg opens and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
The spotty blue egg shakes and rumbles… and a baby dragon pops out! You got it!
scenes.visual_prompt: blue egg cracking baby dragon toy

scenes.narration: Nice job! Can you beat Level Two? Come back tomorrow to find out!
